lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct white vertical line segments observed. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso (approx. 50-60 pixels) but becomes more compressed and irregular in the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: One Y-shaped bifurcation observed on the 9th line from the anterior, splitting in the upper-mid section of the torso.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Lines 9, 10, and 11 exhibit significant discontinuities, appearing as dashed segments rather than continuous lines, particularly in the mid-ventral and posterior sections.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: High-contrast cluster of 8 distinct white spots located on the lower haunch and proximal hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of 3 spots is visible across the mid-section of the thigh, creating a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct white spot on the lower cheek/jaw area; white transverse bands present on the proximal section of all four limbs; white chevron-shaped marking on the bridge of the muzzle.
